A’s central claim that protection is governed by a mechanically robust passive film specifically at grain boundaries is poorly founded—passive films protect exposed surfaces, while grain-boundary segregation and secondary phases can instead promote galvanic attack—and its proposed comparison is insufficiently controlled.
